question: Which bowler has the lowest bowling average per wicket taken?
sql:
-- Find all bowlers with 0 runs conceded and at least 1 wicket
WITH runs_per_bowler AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, 
           COALESCE(SUM(br.runs_scored), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) AS runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored br ON b.match_id = br.match_id AND b.over_id = br.over_id AND b.ball_id = br.ball_id AND b.innings_no = br.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
wickets_per_bowler AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, COUNT(*) AS wickets
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON w.match_id = b.match_id 
      AND w.over_id = b.over_id 
      AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id 
      AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.bowler
)
SELECT r.bowler, p.player_name, 
       r.runs_conceded,
       w.wickets,
       r.runs_conceded * 1.0 / w.wickets AS bowling_avg
FROM runs_per_bowler r
JOIN wickets_per_bowler w ON r.bowler = w.bowler
JOIN player p ON r.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE w.wickets > 0
ORDER BY bowling_avg ASC
LIMIT 5
